About us
ACCELQ is an agentic AI codeless testing platform for web, mobile, API, database, and packaged applications, including SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Workday, MS Dynamics, nCino, Coupa, and ServiceNow. Autopilot, its coordinated system of AI agents, discovers the application, generates the tests, executes them, analyzes failures, heals the suite, and reruns it, all without a person directing each step. That is a categorical difference from AI-assisted tools, which still need someone to design the test flow and apply the fix by hand. A tester can describe a test in plain English and get working automation back. No engineer required.

ACCELQ is a Leader in the Forrester Wave Q4 2025 for Autonomous Testing Platforms, with the highest Current Offering score and the only Customer Favorite recognition in that evaluation. It holds a 4.8 out of 5 rating on G2 and won the AI Breakthrough Award in 2025.

Teams report 7.5x faster automation development, 72% lower test maintenance effort, and 53% cost reduction versus scripted tools.
